title: Update Storage Zone
real_world_story: A warehouse is divided into connected storage cells. When a storage zone is reassigned to a new category, every connected cell belonging to the same zone must be updated.

real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Finding and updating all connected cells of the selected zone

problem_statement: Given a grid representing warehouse storage zones, replace the zone value at a specified starting cell with a new value. Only cells connected to the starting cell through adjacent cells having the same original value should be changed.
task: Update the complete connected storage zone starting from the given cell.
input_format: The first line contains two integers R and C. The next R lines contain C integers representing storage zones. The final line contains four integers sr, sc, and newValue, where sr and sc are the zero-based starting row and column.
output_format: Print the updated grid after performing the flood fill operation.

examples.explanation: Starting from cell (0,1), all connected cells containing the original value 1 are changed to 4.

expected_algorithm.name: Flood Fill using DFS
expected_algorithm.reason: DFS can visit every connected cell belonging to the same storage zone and update it with the new value.

hint: Store the original value of the starting cell.
Change only cells having the same original value.
Continue recursively or using a stack until the complete zone is processed.
real_world_takeaway: Flood fill can model operations where an entire connected warehouse section must be reassigned or updated.
